<div class="card-body">
'''Luke Skywalker''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] from [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty|Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ルーク・スカイウォーカー</span><ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">タトゥイーン以外のロケーションにルークがいる場合、毎ターン、フォースを1多く起動できる。操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に＋3。レッド5を操縦する場合、さらに回避値に＋2。耐：損耗＜3。</span><ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">アナキン・スカイウォーカーの息子。オビ＝ワン・ケノービの弟子。Ｔ－16スカイホッパーに乗って、ベガーズ・キャニオンのウォンプ・ラットを狙い撃ちして操縦技能を磨いた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Luke Skywalker.

'''Card text:''' If Luke is at a location other than Tatooine, he may activate 1 additional Force each turn. Adds 3 to the power of a starship he pilots. When piloting Red 5, also adds 2 to maneuver. Immune to attrition < 3.

'''Lore:''' Son of Anakin Skywalker. Pupil of Obi-Wan Kenobi. He honed his piloting skill by shooting womp rats in Beggar's Canyon from a T-16 skyhopper.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore says he honed his piloting skill by shooting womp rats in Beggar's Canyon; the English lore says his father trained him to fly T-16s there.
<h2>Notes</h2>
'''Luke Skywalker (Japanese Reflections III Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[Luke Skywalker|Luke Skywalker]]. [[Decipher]] released it in [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] in October 2001. The ordinary Japanese expansion printing is [[Luke Skywalker (Japanese)]]. Complete Card List v4 lists checklist R58 at rarity SR. Collector R-numbers are checklist references, not GEMP blueprint IDs.<ref name="checklist">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 31, Reflections III foil cards, R58. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009184033/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 22. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Luke-Skywalker-Reflections-III-Foil-SWCA.jpg|Original Japanese foil face]]. Photograph by Duncan Jenkins.</ref>
